item.title: Core Keeper Tools — Interactive Calculators, Planners & Lookups
item.description: The complete toolbox for Core Keeper — interactive calculators, planners and lookups that run right in your browser. Pick a tool, enter your numbers, and get answers instantly: how much ore you need, which crop makes the most gold, your real odds on a rare drop, or the best food buff before a boss fight.
